# 10 - Odd bytes in streak-note-read (read-only check)

Progress note (10 min): scenario found, cause found, probe done. Rest is the write-up.

## Facts
- Scenario: plugins tests/request-golden/scenarios-extra.ts:576-586. File big.txt = 1100 lines of "l" + final "\n". Size = 2200 B, split("\n") gives 1101 lines.
- Read: core src/tools/tools.ts:960-981 (renderTextRead). Output text = `N\tline` (cat -n style). `_truncCtx.totalBytes = Buffer.byteLength(content)` where `content` = RAW file (:977). totalLines = allLines.length (:978).
- Clamp: core src/tools/truncation-parts.ts:299 `totalBytes = ctx.totalBytes ?? byteLength(output)`. So the Read ctx wins: total = raw file bytes (2200).
- Same file :354 `shownBytes = byteLength(kept)`. `kept` = NUMBERED text cut to 1000 lines = 5892 B (1000 numbers + tabs added). So shown counts numbered text.
- Notice: plugins ma-core-tools-plugin/synthetic-text.ts:137-143 prints both numbers as given. It does no checks.
- Same lines also mix units: "1000/1101 lines" = lines of numbered text vs file lines (these two match; only bytes differ).

## Verdict: (b), by design in effect, but misleading. Not a plugin bug.
Core uses two different strings: shown = numbered text, total = raw file. The ctx comment (truncation-parts.ts:41 "Total bytes the underlying source produced") fits the raw file. The notice text does not say so. So a reader sees "shown 5892 of 2200". It is also (a)-like: both numbers sit in one sentence but measure different things.

## Probe (core dir, bun -e, no files written)
Call truncateToolOutputParts(numbered, {tool:"Read", totalBytes:2200, totalLines:1101, startLine:0}).
Output (fileBytes, fileLines, shownBytes, totalBytes, shownLines, totalLines): `2200 1101 5892 2200 1000 1101`.
Check by hand: numbered 1000 lines = 5892 B. Matches golden.

## Other goldens (same pattern)
- read-truncated and output-preview-read-blob: "shown 12782 of 28890 bytes, 1000/3001 lines". File = 3000 lines "line i\n" = 28890 B raw (checked). 12782 = numbered 1000 lines. Here shown < total, so it looks fine, but the same mix of units. Numbers are consistent with the cause, not independent proof of a different one.
- Also in goldens with "truncated: shown": blob-spill, plugin-tool-clamp (not Read; Unverified, not checked).
- Old core: the golden was added in commit 8319d93/8656bba ("request golden scenarios for the tool-result sites core still builds inline"), so the old core already made 5892 of 2200. The plugin move did not change it. Unverified: I did not run old core code.

## What a fix would change
- Core tools.ts renderTextRead :977 (use numbered bytes) OR truncation-parts.ts :299. Or change notice wording only (plugin synthetic-text.ts:141).
- Golden bytes: only the numbers in this notice: streak-note-read (3 notices, 2200 -> about 5892+ B numbered total, 1101-line total would be about 6.9 KB numbered; Unverified exact), read-truncated, output-preview-read-blob (28890 -> numbered total). Also TUI footer "X/Y B" and info.totalBytes (read by the TUI) would change. Also any text-parity fixture for Read (Unverified).
- No golden change proposed. Lead must approve first.

## Recommendation
Fix later (not M3c): numbers are stable and pinned since the first golden; a fix changes core, the TUI footer and 3+ goldens, and truncation-parts.ts:337-340 already says M3c keeps 0-byte-change. Record it as a known issue; the lead can choose notice wording or numbered total.
